goal: Our parcel desk needs a per-service manifest for end-of-day reconciliation. Add summarize_by_service(shipments) in parcel.manifest. It accepts an iterable of Shipment objects and returns a list of dictionaries sorted by service, each with service, count, weight_grams and charge_cents. Sum individual quote results rather than quoting the combined weight; do not modify the shipments. Empty input returns an empty list. Keep summarize working.
